summary: SF_BUILTIN_NC_v1 passes QA with 5 minor warnings and 0 blockers. All 5 pipeline files reviewed (spec.json pending assembly). Cross-file threading validated: 35 TSK_BLTN_* IDs in sop_modules match 35 rates in production. Opening Count quantification (EA by tier S/M/L/XL) from BuiltIns Quantification System v2.0. 5 paintable items in 2 task groups: openings (ITM_OPENING_S/M/L/XL reused, EA_OPENING UOM) and doors (ITM_BUILTIN_DOOR new, EA UOM). Combined prime+paint with primer conditional on substrate_state. 5 substrate-driven primer systems + 3 QT-driven finish systems, all reusing existing SYS_ IDs. 3 PaintScope-provided opening modifiers (depth, detail, access) from BuiltIns Quantification System. 4 protection zones properly paired setup/teardown. Localized floor protection (floor_workzone, not floor_full) correctly chosen for discrete elements. Door removal/flat painting/cure/reinstall workflow complete. QT2 prohibited (prominent millwork). 1 materials.json PaintScope key error corrected during QA (wall_adjacent zone referenced PS_PROTECT_SF.FLOOR_WORKZONE instead of PS_PROTECT_LF.WALL_ADJACENT — fixed). Human Feedback Gate has NOT occurred — expected for v0.1.0 draft.

run_rule states 'Runs AFTER each coat EXCEPT the final coat'. run_count_formula = 'total_coats - 1'. Coat counts: QT3/QT4 = 2 finish + optional primer = 1-2 interstages. QT5 brush = 3 finish + optional primer = 2-3 interstages.
Satin at QT3+, semi-gloss at QT4+, gloss at QT5 only. Default QT3+satin — no tension. Enforced in resolution.json applicable_enums.
MOD_BLTN_PREP includes: DUST_CLEAN, SAND_OPENING, SAND_DOOR, FILL_OPENING, FILL_DOOR, CAULK, SEAL_MDF_EDGES. Complete NC prep for built-in openings and doors.

Quality tier differences expressed through quality_notes scrutiny definitions in sop_modules.json (QT3=quick, QT4=systematic 3ft, QT5=lighted critical). Production rates use rates_by_tier or rates_by_tier_and_qt with descriptive notes per tier. Not simple multipliers.

Binary tasks: all application (spray/brush opening/door, prime opening/door), setup/cleanup, protection, sanding prep, caulk, hardware, door removal/reinstall (26 total). qt_scaled: fill (2), inspection (2), between-coat sanding (2), repair (PATCH_DEFECTS, SPOT_COAT), touchup (9 total). Correct binary/qt_scaled split.

TSK_BLTN_DOOR_REINSTALL correctly notes 'CONSTRAINT: Minimum 5-7 day cure for waterborne alkyd (QT4+) before closing doors' per FFD SS15.11.3. This is a scheduling constraint documented in the task notes.

All 7 protection tasks have protection_metadata. Setup: FLOOR_PROTECT_WORKZONE (floor_workzone), FLOOR_PROTECT_PERIM (floor_perimeter), WALL_MASK (wall_adjacent), FIXTURE_MASK (fixture_covers). All 4 zones fully paired. floor_workzone: FLOOR_PROTECT_WORKZONE <-> REMOVE_FLOOR_PROTECT. floor_perimeter: FLOOR_PROTECT_PERIM <-> REMOVE_FLOOR_PROTECT. wall_adjacent: WALL_MASK <-> REMOVE_WALL_MASK. fixture_covers: FIXTURE_MASK <-> REMOVE_FIXTURE_MASK.

PROD_MODIFIERS_INCREASE_TIME.details: All modifiers documented as 'effective_rate = base_rate / modifier' in production.json. Height (H1-H3), QT (QT3-QT5), and three opening modifiers (depth, detail, access) correctly use time multiplier pattern. Example documented: DEEP (1.25) * CROWN_VALANCE (1.25) * CRAMPED (1.15) * QT4 (1.30) * H1 (1.0) = 2.34x.

PROD_MODIFIER_STACKING_FLAG.details: Stacking rule documented: 'Flag if stacked modifiers > 4.0x'. Maximum theoretical stack calculated: VERY_DEEP (1.50) * BEADED_ROUTED (1.35) * OBSTRUCTED (1.30) * QT5 (1.50) * H3 (1.50) = 5.93x — would trigger flag.

PROD_DOOR_MODIFIER_INDEPENDENCE.details: Door tasks correctly documented as NOT affected by opening modifiers or height modifiers. Doors painted flat on sawhorses at ground level — independent of built-in geometry.

issues.description: Opening-based production rates (EA/hr by tier S/M/L/XL) are research estimates with no canonical doctrine values. M-tier spray 6 EA/hr (~10 min/opening) is calibration anchor. S/L/XL scaled from SF-equivalent ratios. Brush rates ~2x slower than spray. All flagged as assumptions (A-001 through A-003).
issues.suggested_fix: Flag for field validation. M-tier rate is the critical calibration point — validate with field data. Rate ranges provided. App allows per-task rate adjustment.

issues.description: Opening modifiers (depth 1.0-1.50x, detail 1.0-1.35x, access 1.0-1.30x) from BuiltIns Quantification System v2.0, not from Modifier_Registry.md. These are spec-specific PaintScope-provided modifiers, distinct from the global Modifier_Registry modifiers.
issues.suggested_fix: Acceptable — Opening modifiers are quantification-system-specific. Consider adding to Modifier_Registry as a formal category if used across multiple specs.

issues.description: IN_SF_FLOOR_WORKZONE naming vs convention IN_SF_PROTECT_FLOOR_WORKZONE. The convention for floor protection inputs is IN_SF_PROTECT_FLOOR_* (per MEMORY key conventions). Same issue as SF_ARCH_ELEMENT_NC QA-005.
issues.suggested_fix: Verify canonical input name against id_registry.json during Assembly. If convention is IN_SF_PROTECT_FLOOR_*, update to IN_SF_PROTECT_FLOOR_WORKZONE. Non-blocking for v0.1.0 draft.

issues.description: Door SF estimate (~6 SF/EA) for material coverage planning is a doctrine gap assumption (A-003 in materials.json). No doctrine defines built-in door SF equivalent. Spray overspray waste (20-30%) inside enclosed compartments is also a doctrine gap estimate (A-004).
issues.suggested_fix: Acceptable for v0.1.0 draft. Flag for field validation. 6 SF/door is conservative average across typical residential built-in door sizes.

doctrine_compliance.fine_finish_doctrine: Compliant. Combined prime+paint with conditional primer. Interstage universal at all QTs. QT5 brush 3+ coats (ROUND_BLTN_3FINISH per FFD SS15.10.3). Material systems: SYS_FF_STANDARD_ACRYLIC (QT3), SYS_FF_MODIFIED_URETHANE (QT4), SYS_FF_PREMIUM (QT5). Sheen/QT gate enforced. Roll and Tip method referenced for flat door faces per FFD SS15.6. 5-7 day cure constraint per FFD SS15.11.3.
doctrine_compliance.builtins_quantification_system: Compliant. Opening Count method (EA by tier S/M/L/XL). SF-equivalent conversion for material planning (S~2, M~5, L~10, XL~20). Three opening modifiers (depth, detail, access). ITM_OPENING_* item reuse from closet shelf spec.

doctrine_compliance.protection_and_masking_doctrine: Compliant. 4 protection zones, all properly conditioned. floor_workzone for spray (localized — correct for discrete elements). floor_perimeter for brush. wall_adjacent spray masking. fixture_covers spray-conditional. All zones have paired setup/teardown.
doctrine_compliance.materials_and_consumables_doctrine: Compliant. CON_ prefix throughout. 14 consumables all using existing CON_ IDs. Elevated spackle consumption noted (3-5x standard per Millwork Doctrine). NC overfill-sand-flush method. Consumable categories valid.
doctrine_compliance.conventions: Compliant. CON_ prefix. task_classification. Severity: critical/major/minor. Phase values: setup/prep/prime/interstage/finish/cleanup. All units uppercase. No prohibited patterns detected.

key_characteristics: Opening Count quantification from BuiltIns Quantification System v2.0 — EA by tier S/M/L/XL with 3 modifiers (depth, detail, access). Same method as closet shelf but for general built-in millwork.
5 paintable items in 2 task groups: 4 reused ITM_OPENING_* (EA_OPENING) + 1 new ITM_BUILTIN_DOOR (EA). REUSE OVER CREATION principle — openings are openings regardless of context.
Door/drawer removal workflow: remove in SETUP, paint flat on sawhorses in FINISH_COAT, reinstall in CLEANUP. 5-7 day cure constraint for waterborne alkyd (QT4+) before closing.
Hardware removal/reinstall as distinct EA tasks with PS_META.EA.BUILTIN_HARDWARE driver.
35 tasks total (26 binary, 9 qt_scaled) across 7 modules — moderate complexity, between closet shelf (~20 tasks) and arch element (39 tasks).
3 PaintScope-provided opening modifiers multiply together: depth (1.0-1.50x) * detail (1.0-1.35x) * access (1.0-1.30x). Plus QT (1.0-1.50x) and height (1.0-1.50x). Maximum theoretical stack ~5.93x.
Door tasks independent of opening modifiers and height — painted flat on sawhorses at ground level.
6 proposed new PaintScope keys: 4 opening tier keys + 1 door count + 1 hardware count.
All 8 material system IDs reuse existing entries — 5 primer + 3 finish. Zero new SYS_ IDs. REUSE OVER CREATION.
1 materials.json error caught and corrected during QA (wrong PS key on wall_adjacent zone).
Built-in compartments are enclosed spaces — extended dry times, trapped sanding dust, higher spray overspray waste documented as built-in-specific concerns.

review_notes: Built-in millwork spec successfully bridges the closet shelf (Opening Count method) and fine finish millwork (arch element, wood wall, wainscot) architectures. The 2-group task design (openings + doors) is clean and well-justified — openings share technique across tiers with rate variation, doors have a distinct flat-painting workflow. Item reuse (ITM_OPENING_S/M/L/XL from closet shelf) is a strong REUSE OVER CREATION decision. All 8 material systems reused. Opening modifiers from BuiltIns Quantification System are well-integrated. Production rates are research-based with documented ranges and assumptions. Door cure constraint properly documented. No critical or major issues. 5 minor warnings are documentation/naming/field-validation items.
